item.content:encoded:
The City of Benton Community Services Committee is scheduled to meet Tuesday, August 11th  in the Council Chambers at the Benton Municipal Complex, immediately following the Parks and Streets Committee meetings which begins at 5pm.  The agenda for the meeting is included below.

 

Community Services Meeting Agenda

Council Chambers

August 11, 2026

Immediately Following Parks Committee and Streets Committee, which begin at 5pm

 

Committee Members:

Chair – Evelyn Reed

Vice Chair – Ann Spencer-Cole

Staff Liaison – Jason Lyon, Director of Community Development

 

   I. Establish a Quorum / Call to Order

   II. Recognition of Attendees

   III. STATEMENT OF FOIA COMPLIANCE & ROLL CALL

I affirm that I have not engaged in any prohibited discussion, deliberation, or

polling regarding any item on this meeting’s agenda outside of a properly

noticed and open meeting, in compliance with the Arkansas Freedom of

Information Act, as amended by Act 505 of 2025.

   IV. Approval of July 14, 2026, minutes

   V. New Business

     A. Property Remediations -Code Compliance

        1. 18632 I-30 (Clean-up)

        2. 609 Military Rd (Clean-up)

        3. 801 Brookview Dr (Clean-up)

        4. 2713 Janet Dr (Clean-up)

        5. 1222 Cherry St (Clean-up)

        6. 3002 Sue St (Clean-up)

     B. Ordinance Revising Certain Fees to be Charged by City of Benton

        1. Fees Update for Community Development Department

Old Business

   VI. Discussion

   VII. Other

     A. DRC Monthly Report – July (for review)

VIII. Adjourn

 

For more information on events visit www.mysaline.com/events
